newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude price mounts in late US paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude price mounts in late US paper trading.

text.p: The price of North Sea benchmark Brent crude mounted in active late U.S. paper trading on Thursay, traders said.
Eleven partial August cargoes changed hands between $17.70 and $17.83 a barrel, rounding out the window at $17.80-85 a barrel.
August Brent settled at $17.72 a barrel on London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE).
July/August Brent was shade stronger, trading at minus 27 cents and minus 29 cents a barrel, up from minus 30 earlier.
The spread went out at minus 30/27 cents.
August/September was talked at minus 21/18 cents, while September/October was pegged at minus 20/17 cents.
